When you shut off its straight forward. Just close the valve for water and for gas.

When you turn them back on however it is different.

With water you want to have the faucet closest to the main, one intermediate and further away.

Then slowly turn water back on to allow air to get out and then for 3 to 5 minutes and then turn each faucet off slowly.

With gas you open the valve 1/4 at a time and wait 5 min to smell leaks till done.
